activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1928 as Fleming's representative British scientific-activity year. While working at St Mary's in London he observed the antibacterial effect of a mould culture and named the active substance penicillin; he was also elected Professor of the School that year.

sources.title: Sir Alexander Fleming — Biographical, NobelPrize.org
sources.citation_text: NobelPrize.org records Fleming's work at St Mary's in London, his election as Professor in 1928, and his 1928 observation of the mould effect that led him to name penicillin.
